sub_site: placenta (maternal and fetal side biopsies), term and spontaneous preterm

evidence.quote: We thus obtained placenta tissue and control samples from 20 term and 20 spontaneous preterm births
The V1-V2 regions of the 16S rRNA gene was amplified in each sample using Golay-barcoded primers 27F and 338R
Samples were prepared for metagenomic sequencing with the Nextera XT DNA Library Prep Kit

controls.types: air swab; extraction blank (empty tube); PCR-grade water

evidence.quote: swabs that were opened in the sample processing room and waved in the air (“Air Swab”)
empty tubes that were processed through the DNA extraction (“Blank”)
1.4 billion reads for placenta, 31 million for negative controls

decontamination.tool: exclusion of lineages found in negative controls; removal of artefactual/barcode-misattributed taxa (shotgun)

evidence.quote: When we extracted lineages unique to placenta after excluding those found in negative controls
After filtering out probable artifacts and barcode misattributions (Alteromonas mediterranea, Methanosarcina mazei, and Vibrio campbellii)
Bacterial abundance was quantified using qPCR of the V1-V2 region of the 16S rRNA gene using a TaqMan-based assay

notes: Placenta indistinguishable from negative controls by qPCR, 16S and shotgun. Ralstonia/Pseudomonas = reagent/water contaminants; Sneathia/Lactobacillus interpreted as vaginal contamination at delivery; Alteromonas (artefact) and Vibrio (positive-control barcode misattribution) removed; Kytococcus suggested reagent contamination. Prevotella found in placenta and controls, origin left open (not flagged). Ureaplasma/Mycoplasma possibly authentic in a few preterm cases. Archaea (Methanosarcina, Acidiplasma) not recorded. 40 placentas, 160 biopsies (4 per placenta).
